𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗘𝗖𝗧 𝟭𝟬! 🖐️🔟

Anil Kumble took all 10 wickets for 74 vs Pakistan, Delhi, 7 Feb 1999.
Only the second bowler ever to do it in a Test innings. India won by 212 runs. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #Kumble
